Q5227.reason: Under UCC 2-328(3), once a bid is made in a without-reserve auction the auctioneer may not withdraw the goods, so the woman should prevail.

Q6156.reason: The engineer is unavailable, and the company, which took the deposition, had a similar motive to examine him on the falsified safety reports, so FRE 804(b)(1) former testimony applies.
